stages.name: Growth, deficits and deflationary policy
stages.title: Growth, deficits and deflationary policy
stages.sub: After this, the student can explain how strong growth can cause a current account deficit and why deflationary policies are used to correct it.

steps.q: Household incomes across the country rise sharply this year. What is likely to happen to how much people spend on goods overall, including foreign-made ones?
steps.right: Spending on goods rises, including foreign ones
steps.wrong: Spending on goods falls across the board
steps.hint: When people have more money, do they spend more or less on everything, including things made abroad?
